items.title: SpatialASM: Internalizing Active Mentalization for Spatial Reasoning
items.summary: When solving complex spatial reasoning tasks, ordinary humans naturally revisit the scenes from task-relevant viewpoints and mentally reconstruct the spatial layouts from those viewpoints. But can Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) proactively think in the same way? We term this ability Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM), an intrinsic component of visual intelligence that remains substantially underdeveloped in current LVLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SpatialASM, a scalable framework to internalize ASM into LVLMs through training-time spatial simulation. items.title: Systematic Multi-Agent Vision-and-Language Navigation: Formulation, Benchmark, and Method
items.summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) has largely focused on a single agent following a single instruction, yet many real-world applications require teams of robots to tackle tasks beyond the capabilities of any individual agent. We present Systematic Multi-Agent Vision-and-Language Navigation, providing, to our knowledge, the first systematic formalization of multi-agent VLN as a constrained coordination problem: each mission consists of subtasks carrying dependency and resource constraints (presence locks and holding chains). items.title: Multi-Stream Attention Residuals
items.summary: Attention Residuals (AttnRes) enables content-dependent retrieval over network depth, which can be viewed as single-stream softmax attention along the depth axis. items.title: Humanity's Sixth Sense: Benchmarking Intuitive Visual Reasoning in Multimodal Models
items.summary: Humans perceive far more in a scene than what is explicitly depicted: a single glance captures past causes and future trajectories; a quick peek determines if a vehicle can fit between two parked cars; a few seconds of video reveals who holds authority in a room; and a fleeting clip highlights subtle abstract patterns like unwritten rules or hidden labels. This capacity reflects a form of humanity's sixth sense: an intuitive reasoning mechanism that recovers implicit information beyond raw sensory perception. items.title: Mental-Models for Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: Large foundation models have accelerated progress toward general-purpose agents that interact with humans and other agents through language and multimodal signals. Current agentic systems often operate through prompt design, memory, or end-to-end behavioral shaping, but typically do not learn an explicit partner-state representation that can be reused as a decision variable across tasks. items.title: BudgetPix: Compute-Adaptive Tokenization for Pixel-Space Image Diffusion
items.summary: Most image generation models rely on uniform tokenization, allocating the exact same computational budget to equally-sized image patches. This static paradigm cannot adapt to different resource constraints at inference time, and yields suboptimal quality-cost tradeoff by devoting the same effort to both plain backgrounds and intricate details. We propose BudgetPix, an adaptive tokenization framework that dynamically allocates compute based on visual complexity and spatial layout, enabling flexible computational budgeting at inference time. items.summary: Large language model (LLM) assistants are being deployed to clinicians across health systems, and judgments about their readiness rest largely on benchmark scores, most of them derived from examination questions or curated cases. items.summary: Recovering faithful 3D hand motion from video remains challenging due to frequent occlusions and incomplete visual observations, which make frame-wise pose estimates unreliable and temporally inconsistent. items.title: Few-Step Generation via Data-Space Iteration
items.summary: Flow matching has emerged as a scalable paradigm for training high-quality generative models, but sampling from the learned probability flow requires many network evaluations. Distillation can reduce this cost to one or a few evaluations; however, one-step generation often sacrifices quality, making few-step generation the practical operating regime. Existing few-step methods perform their iterative computation along the probability flow and therefore require a fixed, manually chosen timestep discretization. items.title: GATOR: Generative and Agentic 3D Object Reconstruction From Casual Images
items.summary: Reconstructing complete, scene-aligned 3D objects from casual images requires integrating sparse, uncertain observations and inferring surfaces hidden by occlusions. We present GATOR, a generative and agentic framework that recovers textured object assets and their scene-relative pose from one or more images. items.title: Distributionally Robust Mixture-of-Experts Training
items.summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) transformers scale capacity by activating only a few experts per token, but this sparsity creates a hidden reliability problem: when routing is imperfect, load-balanced models may send tokens to experts that are insufficiently trained for the assigned inputs. items.title: One Model to Loop Them All: Elastic Latent Recurrence for Language Models
items.summary: A latent recurrent language model applies a shared block of layers repeatedly, so one checkpoint can trade inference compute for accuracy by changing the loop count. At one loop, however, such models typically fall well short of a non-recurrent model of the same size, a one-loop tax that makes a separate non-recurrent model the better choice whenever latency matters. We present Elastic Latent Recurrence (ELR), a recipe for training looped language models without this tax. items.summary: Massive activations, residual-stream coordinates with magnitudes far larger than typical activations, are associated with attention sinks in transformers, but how their scale is regulated during training remains incompletely understood. items.title: Self-Preservation in Language Models
items.summary: Continual learning (CL) seeks to adapt pretrained models while preserving prior capabilities. 惊闻现在大学生生活费需要 2000-2500 一个月了
items.summary: 最近从几个亲友对话渠道听到的他们的小孩读大学，生活费在 2000-2500 一个月区间，但是老家的传统行业，一个人工资 3000-4000 太常见了，相当于赚的钱基本一大半给小孩做生活费。 还是很惊讶，我记得当年（ 200x 年）一个月 500 绝对用不完的。当年一个人普通人工资 2000-3000 比较常见，给 500 元给小孩做生活费还算过的去，现在就太吃紧了。 今天看到有 v 友发的麦当劳涨价的帖子（ https://v2ex.com/t/1247855#reply70 ），感慨一下通胀的厉害。

items.title: 大厂十年领了大礼包，孑然一身应该如何选择呢？
items.summary: 32 岁，一直是 Android 开发，10 年 3 段大厂经历，离职前总包 70w ，975 的工作节奏，房子买了又卖，亏了接近 100w ，然后现在手里现金有 260w+，剩下一辆 modely ，是这样的基本信息。 最近刚拿大礼包，花了两个月时间全国到处玩了一圈，期间看了看 AI 发展的速度，深感未来普通研发岗数量会急剧收缩 想和 v 站上的朋友沟通下未来的想法，我目前有 3 个，大家可以提提建议 1.回老家先歇着，几乎没有成本，父母没有养老风险，然后玩玩或者学学习，探索下未来想干啥或者能干啥，完全的跨行 2.继续找 Android 工作，可接受任意城市或者远程。但是不知道当前 Android 工作啥情况，并且还能继续干几年也不清楚 3.转行 FDE ，不知道有没有朋友试了 FDE 这条路线。不过我听了一些 FDE 相关的博客，感觉国内国外 FDE 这个岗位差距巨大。 希望大家伙多聊聊天，如果有问题可以问我，我也愿意知无不言。

items.title: 体检报告已出， 12 项异常
items.summary: 上周体检报告已出： 1.血脂异常：总胆固醇(6.49⬆)、低密度脂蛋白胆固醇(4.03⬆)、载脂蛋白 B(1.45⬆)均升高 2.动脉硬化：双侧颈动脉内-中膜欠光滑，且右锁骨下动脉已出现斑块 3.尿酸增高：尿酸 464⬆ 4.幽门螺旋杆菌阳性 118⬆ 5.肺部结节：右肺结节(Lung-RADS 2 类)显示为 3*2mm 实性结节及 3*3mm 磨玻璃结节 6.血压低：舒张压降低(56↓) 7.双肾结晶 8.⼼电图：窦性⼼律；⼼电轴右偏 得重点关注：幽门螺杆菌 + 血脂和颈动脉斑块

items.title: 作为一个没见过退休金的农村人，我想知道退休职工和体制内退休后退休金有多少钱？
items.summary: 我从来没听说过村里谁家老人是靠“基本养老金”生活的，都是靠子女供养，前几年倒是依稀听过邻居老奶奶说每个月能领一百多。 最近站里关于社保的话题比较多，我在想一百多能干啥，有啥吵吵的。刚才问了下 AI ，AI 说退休职工每个月起码有三四千退休金，给我小小震撼了一把，这退休金比在我们县城打工工资都高。 我之前从来没了解过这些，可能因为我是农村人，认识的人没有退休职工、体制内人士，只有农民。 有没有家里有退休职工/体制内人士的 V 友，能说说这是真的吗？ 退休金到底能拿多少钱？ 我虽然稀里糊涂上了几年班，也随波逐流交着社保啥的，但对退休后能拿多少钱还是一头雾水。

items.title: 用 Codex 很不爽，我退订了，拜拜
items.summary: 月初一天蹬完一周的量，急得没办法准备去开通 200 美元的订阅，结果苹果给我拦了，说是礼品卡有 3 天待审时间。我谢谢你，帮我省了 200 刀。更谢谢你让我换了 Deepseek 。 Astra 现在给我的感觉就是弱智，几乎每一轮都有要返工的点，消耗还贼快，好不容易重置了，开多个任务，卡得要死，而且听说开多任务还会被标记降智？可能我这里已经被降智了？这一系列不爽的点，让我心理负担很重。 这段时间 Deepseek 用下来感觉很爽：速度快、顺畅、即便我描述的不准确，也能理解我的需求，还能看到思考过程，偶有返工，还能放心并发几个任务一起跑。而且敞开用也没心理负担！ 我觉得 O/A 为了赚钱反复背地里搞小动作，一直在耍猴，以前没有替代的我忍了，现在对我来说自家模型基础编码能力也不差了。与其大价钱让 O/A 恶心，不如换到自家的模型。 可能我的项目简单，不需要那么牛逼的模型，个人见解！

items.title: 向下剥削太狠，造就社会各种怪象，包括华为刹车断裂。
items.summary: 这种类似事情都是向下剥削造成的，跟之前的 China GT 安全事故一样，上面给的少下面只能按给的钱办事，这种事情以后层出不穷。 华为刹车踏板就是因为给供货商钱少造成的。 食品安全，交通安全等等都一样个道理，一分钱一分货，最终都是底层互害。 其逻辑底层就是占用绝对生产资料的最高权力这一层向下剥削太狠，每个链条下的人都想生存赚钱，只能不停向下转移，总要传导到生产或服务的最后一环，最终出现各种问题。 其根本原因是禁止公平博弈只有掀桌子的博弈：你敢跟权力博弈要么进秦城，要么关小黑屋或社会性死亡。 自己想想小学食堂，幼儿园食堂，甲醛白菜，杨梅，食品油灌车，远洋捕捞等。 每个活在各自环境中的人要么因为钱少而发泄，要么为了生存而违法。
